description: This file defines the class SugarWidgetSubPanelTopSummaryButton, which extends SugarWidgetSubPanelTopButton. It provides a display method that renders a button within a subpanel widget, supporting access control and generating a popup request with specific parameters.

classes.name: SugarWidgetSubPanelTopSummaryButton
classes.description: A widget class extending the base subpanel top button class, responsible for rendering a summary button with access control and popup invocation.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders an HTML input button for the subpanel, with JavaScript for a popup; considers user permissions.
